title: Cataclysm 1.0: The Catastrophe
prompt:
CORRECTION OF QA-REJECTED RUN 43087177881. Use the complete-release pipeline with FOUR sequential source-preserving passes, not the old two-feature selection. Every release_scope requirement is mandatory and assigned to a pass.

CATACLYSM 1.0: THE CATASTROPHE — explicit creator release order, 2026-11-11. Produce one substantial coherent playable expansion from the actual latest primary 0.9, not a version rename. Have creative freedom within the agreed identity and requirements below. Make it fun to PLAY and WATCH. This is the existing BoRHeZ Games Studio experiment; do not touch the separate Flame Game Studio, other games, credentials, workflows or tests.

EVIDENCE. evidence_drive_file_id is the NEW cataclysm__review-07.mp4 review of 0.9. Consume the complete available private gameplay transcript and sampled visuals via private_playback, extracting EVERY distinct gameplay observation with timestamps where available. Distinguish observations, creator requests and hypotheses. The newest review resolves earlier gameplay ambiguities; keep private speech/media/personal details out of public output. Do not retranscribe review-06 or older recordings. Read the 2026-11-11 release section in game_factory/CATACLYSM_1_0_ROADMAP.md and prior accepted reports.

BASELINE. The primary illustrated 0.9 with physical world, revised audio, fullscreen and eight companions is docs/cataclysm, NOT the older /preview/ archive. Trusted orchestration now targets docs/cataclysm for 1.0. Compare docs/preview read-only and retain/backport compatible accepted living-horde director, enemy mutations, city encounter patterns and tactical rewards. Do not downgrade primary graphics/audio/controls or overwrite archives/branches. Reuse existing systems. Preserve boot handshake, diagnostic API, play/pause/restart/mute/fullscreen and build label required by independent QA.

1. WORLD AND 3-6-9. Deliver the discussed 3-6-9 progression: endless world scrolling DOWN through distinct biome chunks, biome changes about every THREE MINUTES, meaningful milestones rather than only speed/HP inflation. Preserve horizontal looping if useful; replace vertical toroidal wrapping with coherent chunk progression where needed. After player level 9 introduce the rising shadow, with warning, chase pressure and fair escape/counterplay. Implement the LEVEL-99 BOSS and its NINE-DEFEAT endgame as actual tracked game state with distinct feedback and final result/reward. Demonstrate via accelerated deterministic checks, not nine real-time playthroughs. Keep movement responsive and routes legible. Account for the earlier luck/dance biome/progression influence: reconcile its exact meaning with this review, state the implemented rule, and do not silently omit it or invent a precise prior agreement.

2. DIRECTOR AND MUTATION. Use a bounded threat/cost budget, gradual enemy introductions and sensible wave/recovery rhythm: no awkward unexplained empty pauses or punishment spikes for strong builds. Choose varied enemy traits with costs instead of unbounded numbers. Add procedural modular anatomy (legs/tentacles, torso, arms, heads/abilities), tying visible traits to behavior; include readable flying and obstacle-phasing enemies with counterplay. Implement fusion -> visible vulnerable COCOON -> MUTANT with real inherited traits, deterministic bounded combinations and clear telegraphs. Consume parents exactly once; never duplicate rewards or escape the threat budget. Preserve collision/pathfinding for the cat, ground enemies and squad; avoid trapped allies/pickups and teleport hits. Newly spawned enemies, ordinary collectibles, magnets and boosts originate OUTSIDE the visible viewport plus a margin; wrapping/chunks must not pop them into view.

3. BUILDS AND SQUAD. Make main-cat, squad and equipment builds viable, with readable tactical synergies. Companions remain until run end, never 45-second rentals. Keep all EIGHT differentiated types, maximum FOUR UNIQUE active companions. Unlocks appear randomly among three-choice roguelite upgrade offers. After four unique allies are chosen, suppress other unowned unlocks; keep owned upgrades eligible. Preserve healer/tank/shooter plus the five other roles, abilities and useful coordinated behavior. Random pool retains Damage, Fire Rate, Move Speed, XP Gain; companion unlock, damage as fraction of player damage, fire rate, count within cap; Multishot, Bouncing Bullets, companion multishot/bounce and Cat's Catch. Preserve active relics; do not restore the removed aura activation menu. Equipment combinations must change tactics, not only decorate a stat. Avoid artificial progression caps, duplicate/impossible offers and upgrade-menu softlocks. Freeze ALL combat, encounters, simulation clocks and damaging states during choices and pause.

4. EXPLORATION. Magnets remain VERY VERY RARE but last much longer than earlier releases. Collectible boosts also remain very rare. Spawn them beyond the screen so exploration matters, without filling the game with free boosts. Keep health recovery, fish/XP feedback, encounter rewards and boss pressure. Integrate events, biome transitions and shadow without overlapping unavoidable damage.

5. PRESENTATION. Push simplified colorful readable animation. Make the MAIN CAT visibly alive (idle/run/attack/hit); differentiate squad/enemy silhouettes and animate cocoon assembly/emergence. Prior 12-FPS pose idea should retain smooth movement/rendering, aiming at 60 FPS subject to mobile performance. Use restrained particles, hit feedback, depth/2.5D cues and biome mood without hiding hazards. Improve the original hard-rock/DnB soundtrack with adaptive BUILDUP AND DROPS, distinct dubstep boss intensity and biome/event transitions. Sync cues with actions, keep levels controlled, mute/volume persistent and gesture-based browser audio startup. Bound audio scheduling; no external downloads or unrelated musical style.

6. MOBILE. Landscape first: arena, HUD, pause, restart, sound, fullscreen, squad/relic actions and all THREE upgrade choices fit ONE SCREEN. No page scrolling or controls outside/below the play window. Keep portrait fallback and correct touch-to-world scaling on Samsung/mobile browsers. Test 640x320, 844x390, 915x412, desktop and narrow portrait. Keep game title/subtitle/settings and a dashboard link; no studio/devlog/AI-factory tabs inside the game.

STUDIO CONTRACT. Plan the entire fixed ledger before code. Passes: FOUNDATION (world/biomes/progression/shadow/endgame), EVOLUTION (director/traits/fusion), BUILDS (squad/upgrades/equipment/rare exploration rewards), PRESENTATION (animation/audio/mobile and long-run verification). Each pass preserves the same candidate and earlier completed mechanics in a hashed checkpoint. Do not shrink the scope or defer mandatory requirements. Read the attached previous QA rejection and the full new review evidence ledger. Implement every assigned requirement with actual state and executable checks, keeping all baseline controls/boot/read-only diagnostics. Trace requirements to implementation and checks in the required stage report. Final independent QA must judge every requirement; one bounded continuation can finish missing content. Never publish a partial version rename as 1.0. Exact accepted hashes, stable /cataclysm/ URL, dashboard labels and live verification remain required after QA. Preserve archived 0.9 and all other games.
acceptance: Review-07 is consumed with complete available audio and honest sampled-frame coverage; gameplay requirements are traced without publishing private dialogue.
Primary /cataclysm/ ships Cataclysm 1.0: The Catastrophe from latest illustrated 0.9, retaining compatible archived additions while archives and other games stay intact.
Downward biomes change about every three minutes; working 3-6-9 milestones, rising shadow after level 9 and accelerated level-99 boss nine-defeat endgame proof.
Bounded director supports modular enemy traits, fair flying/phasing enemies and fusion-cocoon-mutant inheritance without duplicate parents/rewards or budget escapes.
Eight permanent companion types, four unique active maximum; after four, unowned unlock offers stop while owned upgrades and viable main-cat/equipment synergies remain.
Three-choice random upgrades retain damage/fire-rate/speed/XP, companion stats, multishot, bounce and Cat's Catch; all combat/clocks pause; no softlocks or restored aura menu.
New entities spawn outside viewport; magnets/boosts are very rare, magnets last substantially longer, and exploration/recovery/encounters remain fair.
Readable main-cat/squad/mutant/biome animation, bounded particles/depth and original adaptive hard-rock/DnB buildup/drops plus distinct dubstep boss transitions.
Eight independent browser viewports cover portrait, small landscape and desktop; HUD/actions/three choices fit one screen and real touch/pause/restart/fullscreen/audio work.
Accelerated long-run checks exercise biomes, fusion, synergies, shadow and late boss cycles with bounded state; independent QA covers every scope item or blocks release.
Only accepted exact bytes publish at stable primary URL; dashboard primary labels show 1.0 The Catastrophe; live delivery verifies accepted hashes.
